item.title: Critical vulnerabilities in Fortinet products
item.description: Fortinet have announced critical vulnerabilities in Fortinet products, and are releasing security updates which customers should implement as a priority.
item.dc:creator: Australian Cyber Security Centre (ACSC)

item.title: Critical vulnerabilities in PHP
item.description: A security release for two critical PHP vulnerabilities is set for public disclosure on 22 October 2026. PHP is widely used to power web applications.
item.dc:creator: Australian Cyber Security Centre (ACSC)

item.title: Protecting operational technology and edge devices
item.description: Alert on the cyber security risks to operational technology (OT), including refrigeration and cooling technology, with mitigation advice and guidance for businesses and organisations that operate this technology.
item.dc:creator: Australian Cyber Security Centre (ACSC)

item.title: Critical vulnerabilities in Citrix NetScaler ADC and Citrix NetScaler Gateway products
item.description: Alert for organisations to implement a high-priority patch addressing new vulnerabilities, under active exploitation in Citrix NetScaler ADC and Citrix NetScaler Gateway products.

item.title: Risks of AI misalignment to Australian organisations
item.description: Alert on the risks of AI misalignment to Australian organisations, with mitigation advice and guidance on secure AI practices for organisations.
item.dc:creator: Australian Cyber Security Centre (ACSC)
